messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Portuguese, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Portuguese line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
Ah quão difícil é dizer o que era esta selva selvagem e áspera e densa que no pensamento renova o medo!

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (Step 3)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|--------------------|------------------------|--------| | Ahi | Interjection “Ah!” | Ah | “Ah!” | OK | | quanto | Adverb intensifier “how” | quão | “how” | OK | | a | Preposition infinitive marker “to” | *(omitted)* | – | UNNECESSARY | | dir | Verb infinitive “tell” | dizer | “to say / tell” | OK | | qual | Interrogative adjective “what” | que | “what / that” | OK | | era | Verb imperfect “was” | era | “was” | OK | | è | Verb present “is” | é | “is” | OK | | cosa | Noun “thing” | *(omitted)* | – | MISSING | | dura | Adjective “hard” | difícil | “difficult” | OK | | esta | Demonstrative adjective “this” | esta | “this” | OK | | selva | Noun “forest / wood” | selva | “forest / wood” | OK | | selvaggia | Adjective “wild” | selvagem | “wild” | OK | | e | Coordinating conjunction “and” | e | “and” | OK | | aspra | Adjective “rough” | áspera | “rough” | OK | | e | Coordinating conjunction “and” | e | “and” | OK | | forte | Adjective “strong / dense” | densa | “dense” | OK | | che | Relative pronoun “which / that” | que | “that / which” | OK | | nel | Contraction “in the” | no | “in the” | OK | | pensier | Noun “thought” | pensamento | “thought” | OK | | rinova | Verb “renews” | renova | “renews” | OK | | la | Definite article “the” | o | “the” | OK | | paura! | Noun “fear!” | medo! | “fear!” | OK |
---
### Issues Detected - **MISSING**: *cosa* – the noun “thing” is not expressed in the Portuguese rendering. - **UNNECESSARY**: *a* – the infinitive marker required in Italian is not needed in Portuguese and was therefore omitted.
All other items are correctly translated and grammatically appropriate.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Portuguese script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Portuguese text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 4: - Original: Ah quão difícil é dizer o que era - Issue: MISSING “coisa dura” - Corrected: Ah quão difícil é dizer o que era coisa dura
- Line 5: - Original: esta selva selvagem e áspera e densa - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 6: - Original: que no pensamento renova o medo! - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
